nodes.title: Positive Prompt
widgets_values:
Your task is to generate "try-on" images in which the woman shown in Image 2 changes into the outfits shown in Images 3 and 4.

Use Image 1 as the base composition and garment placement guide.
Use Image 2 only to preserve the original person and scene.
Use Image 3 as the bra design reference.
Use Image 4 as the panties design reference.

Use the bra and panties shown in Image 1 only to determine their position, scale, orientation, coverage, and fit on the body.

Keep the exact person, face, facial expression, hair, hairstyle, body shape, pose, hands, skin tone, background, camera angle, framing, and lighting shown in Image 2.
Keep the color, pattern, lace embroidery, stitching, design, and decorative details shown in Images 3 and 4.
keep the height of panties show in Image 4. Note that Image 4 must not be stretched vertically.

Replace the bra design in Image 1 with the exact bra design shown in Image 3.
Replace the panties design in Image 1 with the exact panties design shown in Image 4.

Do not copy the neutral placeholder colors or garment designs from Image 1.
Do not redesign either garment.
Do not alter the person's anatomy or proportions.
Do not output a collage, reference sheet, split image, or multiple images.
